policy_evidence.claim: Limited Non-Authorized API Data may be stored only as necessary and no longer than 30 days before deletion or refresh.
policy_evidence.captured_excerpt: Limited Non-Authorized API Data may be stored no longer than 30 days before deletion or refresh.

policy_evidence.claim: The privacy guidance prohibits harvesting, tracking, inferring, deriving, or storing information usable to identify a user without consent.
policy_evidence.captured_excerpt: The guidance restricts deriving or storing information usable to identify a user without consent.

policy_evidence.claim: API Data must be removed when required by termination or discontinuance, and stored API Data remains subject to the developer policies.
policy_evidence.captured_excerpt: Stored API Data remains subject to developer policies and removal requirements.

policy_evidence.claim: The product requires a 90-day evidence window, independent authors, and evidence-linked reviewable outputs.
policy_evidence.captured_excerpt: The product requires a 90-day evidence window and stable independent-author checks.

data_classes.name: comment_text
data_classes.refresh_method: Re-fetch each comment before day 30; changed or unavailable text cannot preserve the original frozen bytes.
data_classes.deletion_method: Delete local comment text when refresh fails, the comment disappears, or the retention deadline expires.

data_classes.name: comment_id
data_classes.refresh_method: Use the official comments lookup surface to revalidate the identifier before day 30.
data_classes.deletion_method: Delete the identifier when refresh fails or the deadline expires.

data_classes.name: video_id
data_classes.refresh_method: Revalidate the referenced video through the official API before day 30.
data_classes.deletion_method: Delete the identifier when the video is unavailable or the deadline expires.

data_classes.name: canonical_url
data_classes.refresh_method: Regenerate the URL only after the video and comment identifiers are revalidated.
data_classes.deletion_method: Delete the URL with its underlying identifiers.

data_classes.name: author_derived_identifier
data_classes.deletion_method: Discard any run-scoped author derivative no later than the API Data deadline.

required_gates.reason: The 30-day Non-Authorized API Data limit is shorter than the product's required 90-day evidence window.
Refreshing or deleting comment text changes or removes bytes bound to the frozen dataset and review packet hashes.
The official guidance does not explicitly authorize a persistent cross-run derivative used to track commenter identity.
The project has no executable refresh and purge mechanism that can prove deadline compliance for every stored value.
A mutable 30-day snapshot cannot currently reproduce a frozen 90-day evidence-linked source-quality experiment.

recheck_conditions: Obtain written lifecycle and stable-author clearance or implement a compliant refresh and purge path.
